tool_args.rationale: The paid observations include the specified high-frequency sign-oscillation signature, and the outputs alternate sign. Abstain from predicting the non-stationary behavior.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary smooth models, including barrier-modulated siphon and damped oscillator

The reported oscillation signature already triggers scoped abstention; further measurement is not required.
